abstract: Various embryonal carcinoma cells of different origins were compared as to the ability to form chimeric blastocysts by means of aggregating with normal 8-cell stage mouse embryos. The teratocarcinoma lines examined were OTT6050 and five newly established ones including a spontaneous testicular teratocarcinoma STT-2. The present results have revealed that distinct differences existed in the ability of colonizing blastocysts among teratocarcinomas and also among embryonal carcinoma cell lines. Since STT-2 stem cells were found to be incorporated into blastocysts most efficiently, further development of the blastocysts were examined in utero. It was found that STT-2 stem cells could be incorporated into the fetuses up to the 7-to 28-somite stages. This is the first case to demonstrate that testicular teratocarcinoma cells with the male germ cell origin have the developmental potency to participate into mouse embryogenesis.
abstract_ja: 8細胞期の正常マウス胚と凝集させることでキメラ胚盤胞を形成する能力について、さまざまな起源の胎児性癌細胞を比較した。検討した奇形癌細胞株は、OTT6050と、自然発生の精巣奇形癌STT-2を含む新たに樹立された5株である。本研究の結果、奇形癌間、そして胎児性癌細胞株間でも、胚盤胞へのコロニー形成能に明確な差があることが明らかになった。STT-2幹細胞は胚盤胞に最も効率よく取り込まれたため、胚盤胞のさらなる発生を子宮内で検討した。その結果、STT-2幹細胞は7〜28体節期まで胎児に取り込まれることがわかった。これは、雄の胚細胞起源の精巣奇形癌細胞がマウス胚発生に参加する発生能を有することを示した初めての例である。
